feesNote: Walsall pays two weekly amounts, a fee for the carer and an allowance for each child; the fee is set for the household and depends on the type of carer and how many children are placed.
extras: Birthday and festival payments each worth one week's allowance for the child's age
Summer holiday payment worth two weeks' allowance
No council tax for carers who live in the Walsall borough; carers living elsewhere get a regular payment equal to their annual council tax bill
Current carers receive £1,000 if someone they refer is approved as a foster carer
summary: Walsall's rates apply from April 2026: a weekly allowance for each child in four age bands, plus a weekly household fee that rises with the number of children and is higher for advanced carers. Council tax help and birthday, festival and holiday payments come on top.
